# Websites With Punch

> Websites With Punch is a website monitor for freelancers, agencies and small businesses. It checks each website you add for uptime and response time every minute (Pro and Business) or every 5 minutes (Free), checks SSL certificate expiry and domain expiry once a day, and shows all three on one dashboard. It is a product by Makvion Technologies.

## What it does
- Uptime: an HTTPS request to each site's homepage every minute on Pro and Business and every 5 minutes on Free (following up to 5 redirects) records up/down status, the HTTP status code and the response time. 2xx and 3xx count as up; 4xx and 5xx count as down. A failed check is retried and confirmed from a second location before it is recorded as an outage.
- SSL certificate expiry: reads the live certificate on port 443 daily and shows the days left (amber at 30 days, red at 7).
- Domain expiry: looks up the registrable domain's expiry date daily over RDAP, with a WHOIS fallback, and shows the days left (amber at 30 days, red at 7). Best effort: some country-code registries don't publish expiry dates.
- On demand: any site can be rechecked from its page (once a minute per site), and an opt-in auto refresh rechecks every 60 seconds while the page is open.
- History: up to 90 days of checks per site, with response-time charts (24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, all), uptime percentage, last downtime and a Health Score.
- Alerts: an email when a confirmed check finds a site down and again when it recovers, and 30, 7 and 1 day before an SSL certificate or domain expires.
- Not included: no SMS or chat alerts, no public status pages, and no multi-region monitoring (a second location is only used to confirm a failure).

## Pricing (USD)
- Free: 1 site, $0.
- Pro: up to 10 sites, $12/month or $120/year; optional +5 site packs ($6/month each, up to 30 sites).
- Business: up to 50 sites, $42/month or $420/year; optional +10 site packs ($9/month each, up to 100 sites).
- Yearly billing gives 2 months free. No card needed for the Free plan.

## Free tools (no signup)
- [SSL checker](https://www.websiteswithpunch.com/tools/ssl-checker): issuer, expiry date, days left, covered hostnames and browser trust for any public domain.
- [Domain expiry checker](https://www.websiteswithpunch.com/tools/domain-expiry-checker): registrar, expiry date and days left via RDAP.
- [Website down checker](https://www.websiteswithpunch.com/tools/website-down-checker): status code, response time and final URL from our server.
